messages.author: ad43bdf68bb85dba
messages.subject: How to access private data
parts:
To access private data, you have to obtain a key from MG-RAST, and then enter it into matR.

To obtain a key, log into your MG-RAST account (metagenomics.anl.gov).

Click on the "account management" icon (a green bust directly to the right of your name):





In the account management page, click on the button to manage your preferences: 

At the bottom of the manage preferences page, click on the "generate new key" and then "set preferences" buttons
Copy the key from the text box, and note the expiration date. You'll have to create a new key by that date to access your data:


Copy the key and enter it into matR in one of two ways

# Start matR in R

library(matR)

# Enter the following command

msession$setAuth()

# Press enter, paste your key into the prompt, and then press enter again
# or enter the command this way

msession$setAuth(file="my_key.txt")

# Where "my_key.txt" is a single line text file that contains your key

# Note -- be careful with your key. Anyone can use your key to access your private data.
# MatR deleted the key when the R session is terminated.
# Now you'll be able to access your private data with matR!

messages.author: 4ad48a1892b8a420
messages.subject: Re: How to access private data
parts:
If you have trouble accessing private data - even with a key, make sure that your key is up to date.
To keep your data secure, keys have a limited lifespan (at present, a week).
To ensure that your key is up to date, check it's expiration date.
Follow the instructions above and look for the box labeled "webkey termination date"
directly underneath your key.

If your key has expired, you can generate a new one by clicking on "generate new key"
and then "set preferences". Replace the expired key with the updated one in your
R/matR session.
